captures.name: box
captures.title: One box over every session
captures.body: This searches what the agents actually said and did, not just the names you gave the runs. A session you never labelled is still findable by what it touched.

captures.name: before
captures.title: Everything you have run is in here
captures.body: Live runs and finished ones alike. Count the rows now — the next two steps will cut this list down in front of you.

captures.name: text
captures.title: Type a word the run would have used
captures.body: Try “pagination”. A plain word is matched against the transcripts themselves, so you find a session by what it touched rather than by what you called it.

captures.name: facet
captures.title: Turn a word into a condition
captures.body: Replace it with “label:backend”. Prefixes like label:, machine: and status: filter instead of searching, and the box offers the values it already knows.

captures.name: combined
captures.title: Stack them to answer a real question
captures.body: Conditions and free text apply together: status:failed with a word finds the run that broke on the thing you half-remember. That is the whole query language.

captures.name: cleared
captures.title: Empty the box to get the fleet back
captures.body: Clear it and every session returns. Nothing was hidden or archived — search only ever changes what this list shows you.
